name: deliberAIde
tagline: Human-Centred AI That Supports Dialogue at Every Step
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Proprietary platform dependency; reliance on third-party language models and cloud infrastructure
academic_citations: Limited peer-reviewed publications; primarily case studies and practitioner reports
policy_outcomes: Used in UK government consultations and EU participatory processes; contributes to evidence-based policymaking through structured dialogue analysis
outcome_methodology: Case study analysis, participant feedback surveys, policy adoption tracking
published_performance_metrics: Proprietary metrics; limited public performance data
documented_limitations: Language model biases in non-English contexts; potential for algorithmic bias in theme clustering; limited transparency on training data
jurisdictional_scope: International with focus on UK and EU
failure_modes: Language processing errors in minority languages; potential misrepresentation of nuanced dialogue; dependency on quality of input data
curation_criteria: AI-assisted moderation with human oversight; customizable content policies per deployment
contributor_governance: Closed development model; no public contribution process
disparity_tracking: Limited documented equity analysis; platform designed for accessibility but no published disparity assessments
community_ownership: No community ownership model; corporate-controlled platform
legal_regulatory_issues: Subject to GDPR compliance; data protection considerations for dialogue transcripts
ai_involvement: AI-powered platform with real-time transcription in 100+ languages, automatic anonymization, translation, theme clustering, custom tagging, and interactive visualization
